categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Labeled 'Wallet' and modifies wallet descriptor handling, imports, and keypool logic in src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.cpp and src/wallet/imports.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes node aborts and signed integer overflows triggered when importing descriptors with edge-case ranges ending near 2^31-1. The PR description notes that importing range [2147483647, 2147483647] or using an oversized -keypool 'narrows to a negative value and aborts the node during keypool top-up,' writing an inverted range to the wallet.
